text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(The moment I rounded the fourth<n>corner and came
in front of the<n>stands, I honestly thought my legs
were going to give out.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(The crowd was roaring, their eyes all<n>on me. I
could feel the voices—so<n>many voices—closing in...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(I thought that maybe I hadn't made<n>any progress
at all, but then...)
choice_data_list: Dober! Stay strong! Show 'em what you've got!
Dober! Stay strong! Show 'em what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... can do this! Hryahhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will! Watch me! Hryahhh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(My vision is blurry, my legs won't<n>stop shaking,
and my heart feels like<n>it's about to explode!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But that just proves... how hard I ran!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I ran with all my strength! In an actual<n>race!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh... Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-it's not that big a deal... This is just<n>the first step,
nothing to get that<n>excited over.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-this is just my debut! It's<n>embarrassing to see
you get so<n>excited over me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, um...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm sorry. I don't mean that. I'm...<n>actually
really happy too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was able to finish that race without<n>any regrets
because of you, so...<n>thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I heard you cheering for me... Thank<n>you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Afterward, while packing up our<n>things...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hello, Dober!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on your debut!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Bright... Thank you. I couldn't have<n>done it without
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You were so cool out there, Dober!<n>We could feel
your muscles pulsing<n>from the stands!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-you don't mean literally, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, though. I appreciate you<n>saying that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
That was a fine run, Dober. I hope<n>you'll continue
to do your best in the<n>races ahead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I will! Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. I hope you'll come cheer me<n>on when it's
my turn to debut, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I'll be sure to show you a<n>breathtaking race myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Of course, I'll be there. Train hard,<n>okay?

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Next up, we're spotlighting a rookie<n>you should
keep an eye out for in the<n>Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober debuted just the other<n>day, and as
an up-and-comer of the<n>Mejiro family, it's no
surprise she's<n>already gaining attention...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's not long before the world pins<n>Dober as the
Mejiro family's new<n>hope. We'll have to work
even<n>harder to meet their expectations!
